notes.title: The Spring Sale is here!
notes.content:
Hey PANICORE fans!

As announced a few days ago we're starting off with the biggest sale in PANICORE's history! Grab Panicore with 33% off and have a good time with your friends! 🎉

We would love to animate you to try out the [b]public beta version[/b] as it features [b]2 new game modes to test out[/b]! 🎮

notes.title: Spring Sale Discount and Game News
notes.content:
Hey PANICORE fans!

We're excited to share that Steam has given us the opportunity to be featured on the Front Page during the Spring Sale, running from March 13th to March 20th! 🎉 To celebrate, Panicore will be 33% off – so this is the perfect time to grab it or recommend it to your friends! 

[h2]Game Development Updates[/h2]

We also want to take this opportunity to share some exciting news about the game's progress:

[list]
[*] The new map is still in development, but the new monster and gameplay mechanics are already done!
[*] For those who are curious, we have added two new game modes to the [b]public beta[/b] (these are still in [b]testing[/b]!):
[list]
[*] Low Oxygen Mode
[*] Outbreak Mode
[/list]
[/list]

Jump in and see what surprises they have in store! 😈

We’d love to hear your feedback on these new modes, so let us know your thoughts! 
Additionally, the Submarine Monster now has a special ability in the Submarine Map, making the gameplay even more intense. 

More announcements regarding the new map will follow soon!

Thank you for your continued support, and enjoy the sale! ❤️

Your two brothers at ZTEK Studio 🎮

notes.title: Major Update 1.1 is here!
notes.content:
[h2]The update is here[/h2]

[b]PANICORE Fans[/b]!

Today’s the day! [b]Release Version 1.1[/b] is here, bringing you the [b]Abandoned Submarine Map[/b] and so much more, thanks to your feedback! We’ve listened to as many of your suggestions as possible, and we’re confident that version 1.1 offers a smoother and more refined experience compared to 1.0.10.

Many players faced technical issues that prevented them from fully enjoying the game—most of these errors should now be fully [b]GONE[/b]!

The [b]Abandoned Submarine[/b] is similar in size to the School map but brings fresh gameplay elements and challenges. You might need a new strategy to navigate it—it's up to you to figure that out!

All that being said, let's say the [b]next planned map[/b] will be the exact opposite in size! However, we [b]can't make any estimations[/b] for the release of another map yet, since it takes a while to get things working :) 

We wish you an early Happy Halloween and hope you enjoy the update! 🎃

Catch you in the game! 
Your two brothers at ZTEK Studio


[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]

[b]Panicore Release Version 1.1 (from October 25th 2024)[/b]

[i]Additions:[/i]
[list]
[*] Added Voice Chat settings [b]making you hear your own voice[/b] so you can set up things more precisely

[i]Removals:[/i]

[*] Removed Discord RPC for now, suspected of causing crashes and invitations didn't work - implemented mentioned invitation codes instead

[*] Fixed a bug where the welding kit in Asylum couldn't be used for multiple keycards
[*] Fixed a bug where the first time startup FPS limit was not set right, could be unlocked without the player knowing it
[*] Fixed a bug where glass items would spam visual FX on drops
[*] Fixed a bug where inspecting documents had a font that is incompatible with some languages
[*] Fixed a bug where the wrong monster was shown as a jumpscare when getting killed
[*] Fixed a bug where the Asylum bad ending didn't have sound
[*] Fixed a bug where random entities got stuck in School map's car
[*] Fixed a bug in the Hospital where a rack could spawn invisible

[*] Fixed a bug in the Hospital where dropped items in the rear part of the helicopter couldn't be picked up anymore
[*] Fixed a few invincibility spots on all maps
[*] [b]Fixed DLSS and FSR behavior to reduce number of "Fatal Error" crashes[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed "LowLevelFatalError: cuvidGetDecoderCaps [NVDEC]" crash[/b]
[*] Fixed a spot with a hole in the ground in Hospital
[*] Fixed a few spots in the Asylum where the Asylum lady could get stuck
[*] Potential fix for Voice Volumes not being saved over levels
[*] [b]Potential fix for "Fatal Error" being caused by audio settings[/b]
[*] Potential fix for Asylum elevator pushing players down
[*] Potential fix for items disappearing after being dropped
[*] Potential fix for voice chat not working for some people
[*] Potential fix for a bug where the Asylum lady could be stuck in downed players
[*] Potential fix for a bug where the Asylum lady chilled with players in the elevator
[/list]

[i]Other:[/i]
[list]
[*] Upgraded to Unreal Engine version 5.4
[*] [b]FSR version upgrade to FSR3.1[/b]
[*] [b]DLSS Frame Generation has been included[/b]
[*] Took steps to stop hackers from invading lobbies
[*] [b]The game makes automatic save backups of your level, XP and money now, can be found in the game's AppData folder[/b]
[*] Much better Korean language translations
[*] Much better Italian language translations
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update 1.1 News
notes.content:
PANICORE Fans!

A huge thank you for all your support! You've helped us improve the game by reporting bugs, suggesting features, and testing the public beta. Thanks to you, we've fixed issues that impacted many players.

Now, we’re excited to announce PANICORE’s first Major Update (Release Version 1.1), coming [b]October 25, 2024[/b]! The highlight? [b]The Abandoned Submarine[/b]. Detailed patch notes will be available with the release.

Here are some key updates:

[list] 
[*] [b]New Map[/b] with fresh gameplay elements 
[*] [b]PAINCORE+[/b] mode: Featuring [b]two[/b] entities for an extra challenge 
[*] [b]Voice Chat rework[/b]: Select your microphone and adjust settings in-game 
[*] AI Voice Recognition: Now includes a [b]calibration menu[/b] for fine-tuning 
[*] [b]Party Mode[/b] added to the lobby 
[*] [b]Rejoin Button[/b] in the main menu after disconnects
[*] LowLevelFatalError: cuvidGetDecoderCaps [NVDEC]: [b]Fully fixed[/b]
[*] General [b]crash fixes[/b] and [b]optimizations [/b]
[*] [b]FSR3.1[/b]: Over [b]100 FPS[/b] on a [b]GTX 660[/b], tested on [b]GT 640[/b] with playable results 
[*] [b]DLSS Frame Generation[/b] has been implemented for improved performance
[/list]

Stay tuned for the full patch notes!

notes.title: Public Beta Testing Invitation for Version 1.0.11
notes.content:
Hey Panicore fans!

We have been working on quite a big patch to get rid of the problems Panicore has and we would like to invite you to check out the current [b]public beta version 1.0.11[/b]! It comes with a lot of changes, especially [b]players having voice chat[/b] issues should check this one out. If you want some more action, also [b]check out PAINCORE+[/b], featuring [b]2 monsters[/b] on one map!

To switch to the beta [b]select "beta - Testing new stuff" in Properties->Beta[/b]. 

[b]Why a beta phase?[/b]
We are preparing for the [b]release of the new map[/b]! A lot has been changed on the technical level of Panicore to make the game more stable and this public beta will decide if Panicore is ready for the new map [b]around next week[/b] or if it still needs some time to get ready!

To be more transparent with you about all this: We are trying to become better game developers, still learning how to handle future updates for our games. Deciding what to prioritize and include in a patch, estimating the release of patches, testing them thorougly and releasing them, all these are things we want to do CORRECTLY. Panicore is our second title, but our first to have such a big recognition. We were almost unknown before Panicore's release so this is very exciting and a lot of work at the same time.

All in all, the changes for version 1.0.11 are the following:

[*] Added Voice Chat settings making you hear your own voice so you can set up things more precisely

notes.content:
After around 2 additional days of testing for 1.0.10 we are now sure that the update is ready for you guys! Meanwhile we have also fixed some more bugs for this version! The AI should feel much more enjoyable and we are sure this is the most stable version we have right now!

[b]IF THIS CAUSES MANY PROBLEMS AGAIN LET US KNOW IMMEDIATELY![/b]

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Metal cutter spawns are more obvious now
[/list]

[b]Additions:[/b]

[list]

[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fix for Asylum lady getting you in the elevator which made people inside bug out
[*] Fixed some door spots where the AI could see through it and spot you through the door
[*] Fixed a bug where nametags of new players joining did break the nametag system
[*] Fixed a bug where you could open the chat widget when dead (broke the chat system a bit)
[*] Fixed a bug where chat couldn't be closed by pressing enter after tabbing out of the game
[*] Fixed a spot where files could not be collected in the Asylum
[*] Fixed a spot in Hospital where players could get stuck
[*] Fixed a spot in the Asylum where players could get stuck
[*] Fixed a spawning spot for Asylum gate key so it is more visible (was half in the ground making it really hard to see ... really sorry for that)
[*] Potential fix for randomly getting level 0 and 0$
[*] Potential fix for chat bubble crashing the game
[*] Potential fix for getting killed through doors/walls/distance (it still happened >_>)
[/list]

[b]Some of the TODOs For 1.0.11:[/b]

[list]
[*] Change item drop behaviour so they can't get out of reach anymore
[*] Change AI collision and navigation to make random entity mode work better for every level
[/list]

notes.content:
Again, we had a lot of player feedback and would like to include some into the next version! 
This version should be much more playable in terms of AI, since there were some inconvenient problems that made the gameplay extremely hard! This one should make the game much more fun to play! :)

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Increased Asylum Door Key spawns
[*] Increased general item spawn rate in Hospital due to its size
[*] Reworked Polish translations 
[*] Volume bar now reacts to opening and closing doors
[*] Volume bar now reacts to flashlight sounds
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a severe bug where the AI actually sometimes knew exactly where you were without seeing or hearing you, mostly happened while hiding and being silent - really sorry for that :(
[*] Fixed a bug where the AI could actually see the speech bubble UI of players, even invisible ones, which caused them to see through walls (UI widgets can be pretty big in world space in Unreal Engine and I don't know how we missed that o.O)
[*] Fixed a bug where players could get stuck next to the PC in the Lobby 
[*] Fixed a bug where the player name was shown weird in the volumes section
[*] Fixed some AI navigation problems in the Asylum making the lady get stuck

[/list]

Happy Gaming! :)

[/list]

notes.title: Panicore v1.0 Release Log
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]
We are excited to announce the official release of Panicore v1.0! After months of hard work, testing, and feedback from our amazing community, the full version of Panicore is now available. Thank you for your continuous support, your love and enthusiasm! You are the reason we are motivated to keep going!

[h1]Full Game Highlights[/h1]
Panicore's full version comes with MUCH more than what the demo had to offer! If you liked the demo, you will LOVE the full version. Here’s a look at what you can expect in Panicore v1.0:

[list]
[*][b]New Environments:[/b] Explore an abandoned school, a hospital and an asylum, with each having different escape routes and dangers
[*][b]New Creatures:[/b] Every environment comes with their own creature, each having their own traits
[*][b]Impoved AI: [/b] With your feedbacks on the demo and our beta testers we have been able to improve the general AI to a much smarter, more reliable and fair state
[*][b]Enhanced Gameplay Mechanics:[/b] Improved player movement, quick time events, stun mechanics and more for a better gameplay experience
[*][b]Hidden lore elements:[/b] Find out about what's going on in every environment step by step and set up your theories 
[*][b]Enhanced Visuals:[/b] Post Processing and lighting have been adjusted to match the game's general athmosphere and lore, enjoy a much better looking game with no additional costs in performance
[*][b]Soundtrack and Audio Effects:[/b] Dance to your favourite tracks in the lobby or get terrified by the environments' ambience sounds and enjoy the improved jumpscare sounds
[*][b]Achievements and Progression system:[/b] Unlock a variety of achievements and gather XP as an explorer by solving tasks
[*][b]Ingame money and Character Skins:[/b] Find and collect money while escaping to unlock unique character skins
[*][b]Discord Rich Presence:[/b] Let your friends know which map and difficulty you are on to make them jealous!
[*][b]Additional Lobby fun:[/b] Enjoy more minigames, more soundtracks and other fun additions to the lobby while waiting for your friends!
[/list]

[h1]General Changes[/h1]
Based on player feedback and our ongoing development, we have made several updates and improvements:

[list]
[*][b]Added Input device selection: [/b] A bug prevented input devices to be selectable in the demo, this should now be possible ingame
[*][b]Optimized Performance:[/b] General performance improvements to ensure a smoother gameplay experience, we have even tested the game successfully on a GT640 (which is amazing considering the card is around 12 years old by now)
[*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Resolved various bugs and glitches reported by players and our beta testers to ensure a more stable and enjable game
[*][b]Tutorial and Hints:[/b] Added more hints of what to do to help you a little with each environment and escape
[*][b]UI Enhancements:[/b] Updated the user interface for better clarity and usability
[/list]

[h1]Additional Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Save Data:[/b] Please note that save data and settings from the demo version might carry over to the full version, meaning you could have a higher player level right at the start and not the optimal settings intended for the gameplay. [b]We recommend starting over by deleting the Panicore folder in AppData/Local/[/b]
[*][b]Feedback:[/b] We are always looking for ways to improve Panicore. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please reach out to us through our Discord server!
[/list]

[h1]Thank You![/h1]
We want to extend a huge thank you to everyone who played the demo, provided feedback, and supported us throughout the development process. Your input has been invaluable, and we can’t wait for you to experience the full version of Panicore.

Stay tuned for more updates, and happy gaming!

[b]Best regards,[/b]
Your team at ZTEK Studio

notes.title: PANICORE DEMO PERFORMANCE UPDATE
notes.content:
A lot of people were having performance issues. We found the sources and changed a few things:

[list]
[*] TAA is the default AA method instead of TSR now, TSR drains a lot of power. [b]We suggest to turn your Anti Aliasing Method to TAA if you haven't done this yet[/b]
[*] Nanite has been removed, since the project does not benefit from what it's offering
[*] With Nanite going, we switched from Virtual Shadow Maps to the "normal" Shadow Maps Unreal Engine 5 offers
[*] Optimized a lot of LODs to make the game run on lower end machines better as well
[*] Usage of more static lights to avoid dynamic shadows draining more power
[*] Changed up a few culling parameters so more stuff that doesn't have to be rendered is not being rendered
[/list]

Most of the changes won't be noticeable for the majority of players. For now, the game running well for everyone has the highest priority and we're taking those few losses in visual quality. However, we are not done with performance patches, so if things look a bit rough around the edges be sure it will be better in the future and run better as well.

Hopefully this helps everyone and have fun playing!

Your team at ZTEK Studio
